After the onset of the Waveworn Phenomenon, abnormal weather patterns drained most of these water sources, leaving the lake area dry and giving rise to Tacet Fields and TDs.|Flocks of the Extraordinary II}} '''Desorock Highland''' is a region in [[Huanglong]]. The region is in northwestern Jinzhou and borders the [[Central Plains]] and [[Norfall Barrens]]. The area features a frontline where many battles against TDs were fought, and there are multiple military bases and exile camps in the region. ==Areas== {| class="article-table alternating-colors-table tdc1" style="width: 100%;" ! style="width: 200px;" | Name !
